title: Pin the reviewed store-readiness record (#379, review #431) under the split milestone and re-pin status references
body:
## Goal
Review #431 (codex GPT) accepted the replacement store-readiness record from owner request #379 for capability #268. The record is on main but is not indexed in benchmark/preparation.json. Expected gain: the split milestone evidence index pins the reviewed executed store record, so later sessions and the owner can verify it by hash. The next Policymaker checks the evaluator reference count and the new pins.

## Acceptance
- [ ] Write the marked .session/report.md in your first turns (status wip); update it before Finish.
- [ ] Gate by python3 -I script before editing: sha256 of benchmark/split/store-readiness-268.redacted.json is 019a3e48cd2066aca423ea334631395299322cb50bf61f5be458d44f518a836f and equals the value in benchmark/split/store-readiness-268.redacted.json.sha256; sha256 of benchmark/preparation.json is 25cf0059164b7ec7d3be88f0bca00dbb16ccac85a82c0f8b28d5b6a7a31c1d35. Stop with status blocked if a value differs.
- [ ] Add the record and its .sha256 sidecar to the split milestone pins in benchmark/preparation.json, in the same entry format as the existing split pins.
- [ ] In benchmark/preparation-status.json, keep the split label design-reviewed. Append one limitation sentence to the split milestone: the replacement store-readiness record (sha256 019a3e48...) from workflow revision 4 runs 42480130998 and 42480355765 was independently accepted by review #431 (GPT family; record produced by the owner workflow); synthetic sentinels only; scorer-token continuity and deletion are owner-attested; no real case is allocated. The appended sentence also states that it supersedes the clause 'the restricted store (capability #268) is not ready' in the lineage limitation, and that the generator text in benchmark/scripts/lineage.py needs a later run with LABVIEW_ENVIRONMENT. Do NOT edit the existing lineage-generated limitation text (it starts 'Public lineage inventory is prepared' and ends 'No evaluation allocation or readiness claim.'): lineage.py --check regenerates it and compares bytes. Append the new sentence at the end of the limitations string.
- [ ] Re-pin every reference to preparation-status.json in preparation.json. Both JSON files use json.dumps(indent=2, sort_keys=True) plus a newline.
- [ ] Run python3 -I -B policy/evaluator/evaluate.py --check: exit 0, errors [], missing [], at least 73 references, benchmark_ready false, benchmark_executed false. Run python3 -I -B benchmark/scripts/split_boundary.py --check: exit 0. Report the new sha256 of both preparation JSON files and the reference count.
- [ ] Change only benchmark/preparation.json and benchmark/preparation-status.json. Do not run git commit; do not use git diff or git status as acceptance checks. Compare printed sha256 values only.

## Verification
`python3 -I -B policy/evaluator/evaluate.py --check`

## Context
- Review #431 report snapshot: .github/loop/data/session-reports/431/023fd7eb93138d2a6fae1385dc423c7b0ad9bbaa31cdb273138d78c10addc4f7.json (verdict accept, no correction).
- Earlier pins with the same pattern: the #369 runner pin and the #421 change-case/precision pin (commit 2d95dba).
- The engine runs Verification again without LABVIEW_ENVIRONMENT; the evaluator check is environment-free.

## Budget
At most 12 tool calls and 200k input tokens. Do not open development case JSON files, benchmark/lineage.json or benchmark/results/challenges.json.
